# Do the standard checks catch it?

Thresholds: KS &le; 0.1, |&Delta;&rho;| &le; 0.1, TSTR &ge; 0.95.

KS and &Delta;&rho; are over the predictors only. Some methods rebalance the outcome by design, so the class rate is reported separately rather than scored.
